verdict.rationale: Datadog documents first-party OpenTelemetry support (ingesting OTLP, using OTel SDKs/collector with Datadog as backend), which supports instrumenting once with open standards. However, evidence doesn't show deep parity between OTel-based and native Datadog Agent instrumentation (e.g., feature gaps, correlation limitations) or independent confirmation of true backend portability without re-instrumentation; community comments note weaker data correlation than competitors, suggesting some vendor-specific dependencies remain. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of full parity/portability across backends, documentation of any OTel feature gaps vs native instrumentation.
